chapter_en: Chapter 36: Conferment of titles and patents

units.chapter_en: Chapter 36: Conferment of titles and patents
units.title: 恩封诰命总纲：以文书为主、官鬼为凭；欲知紫诰赠何人，卦内还须分六亲——父作皇封世作己，官为吏部五为君，更将太岁为天子，乾卦当称帝王尊，君位怕临空与绝，五爻忌克世和身；凡占诰命父母为用爻，不绝不空终须有望

rule.yi: 占恩封诰命，以文书爻为主，以官鬼为凭据。想知道诰命要赠给谁，卦里要分六亲：父爻当作皇帝的封诰，世爻是自己，官爻是吏部，五爻是君王，再把太岁当作天子，乾卦应当称作帝王的尊位；君位怕落空和绝，五爻忌克制世爻和身爻。凡是占诰命，父母爻是用爻，不绝不空，终究有指望；又看世爻是自己、官爻是吏部、五爻是天子、太岁是朝廷，都不要落空亡；代表君位的爻，千万不要伤身、克世；乾卦也代表君王，不论内卦外卦得到这个象的，一定受到恩封。
rule.en: In divining about an honorific patent, take the document as the chief and Pressure as the ground. To know on whom the imperial patent will be conferred, one must distinguish the six kin in the hexagram: Resource is taken as the imperial patent, the Self is oneself, the star of office is the Board of Personnel, the fifth line is the sovereign, and Tai Sui is further taken as the Son of Heaven; the Qian hexagram is called the honoured emperor; the sovereign's position fears Void and extinction, and the fifth line must not control the Self and the Body. In every divination about a patent, Resource is the Subject line, and if it is not extinct and not Void there must in the end be hope; look also at the Self as oneself, the star of office as the Board of Personnel, the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the court, none of which may be Void; the line of the sovereign's position must on no account hurt the Body or control the Self; the Qian hexagram also stands for the sovereign, and whoever gets this image, inner or outer, will surely receive the conferment.

zh: 以文书为主，官鬼为凭。
yi: 以文书为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the document as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 欲知紫诰赠何人，卦内还须分六亲，
父作皇封世作己，官为史部五为君，
更将太岁为天子，乾卦当称帝王尊，
君位怕临空与绝，五爻忌克世和身。
yi: 想知道紫诰（皇帝的诏书）要赠给什么人，卦里还要分六亲；
父爻当作皇帝的封诰，世爻当作自己，官爻是吏部，五爻是君；
再把太岁当作天子，乾卦应当称作帝王的尊位；
君位怕落在空亡和绝，五爻忌克制世爻和身爻。
en: To know on whom the imperial patent will be conferred, one must still distinguish the six kin in the hexagram;
Resource is taken as the imperial patent and the Self as oneself, the star of office is the Board of Personnel and the fifth line is the sovereign;
and Tai Sui is further taken as the Son of Heaven, and the Qian hexagram is to be called the honoured emperor;
the sovereign's position fears Void and extinction, and the fifth line must not control the Self and the Body.

zh: 凡占诰命，父母为用爻，不绝不空，终须有望。
又看世为自己，官为吏部，五爻为天子，太岁为朝廷，皆莫空亡。
君位之爻，切莫伤身克世。
乾卦又为君王，或内或外得此象者，必受恩封。
yi: 凡是占诰命，父母爻是用爻，不绝不空，终究有指望。
又看世爻是自己、官爻是吏部、五爻是天子、太岁是朝廷，都不要落空亡。
代表君位的爻，千万不要伤身爻、克世爻。
乾卦也代表君王，不论内卦外卦得到这个象的，一定受到恩封。
en: In every divination about a patent, Resource is the Subject line, and if it is not extinct and not Void there must in the end be hope.
Look also at the Self as oneself, the star of office as the Board of Personnel, the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the court, none of which may be Void.
The line of the sovereign's position must on no account hurt the Body or control the Self.
The Qian hexagram also stands for the sovereign, and whoever gets this image, inner or outer, will surely receive the conferment.

note.yi: 「诰命」是皇帝授予官员及其亲属的封赠文书，「紫诰」是用紫泥封的诏书；「史部」的「史」是「吏」的误写，译作「吏部」，管官员任免的部。「皇封」是皇帝的封诰。「乾卦」是乾，天和君的象。「五爻为天子，太岁为朝廷」与上书、面君两章同取（EL.89、EL.91）。「用爻」就是用神：这里是父母爻。
note.en: 'Gaoming' is the document by which the emperor confers titles on officials and their kin, and 'zigao', the purple patent, is an edict sealed with purple clay; the 'shi' of 'shi bu' is a miswriting of 'li', and it is translated 'Board of Personnel', the board in charge of appointing and dismissing officials. 'Huangfeng' is the emperor's patent of enfeoffment. 'The Qian hexagram' is Qian, the image of heaven and the sovereign. 'The fifth line is the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui is the court' is taken as in the chapters on submitting memorials and on an audience (EL.89, EL.91). 'Yongyao', the Subject line, is the Subject: here the Resource line.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 36: Conferment of titles and patents
units.title: 恩封诰命：君爻生合何爻处便见天恩赐那人——财象遇生封妻室、子爻逢合荫儿孙、世身若得君相合品级加增作大臣；五爻与太岁生合父母必赠椿萱，生合财爻必封妻室，生扶福德当荫儿孙，生合世身再加官爻旺相自当品职高升

rule.yi: 君爻生合哪一爻，就看到天恩赐给那个人：财爻遇生，封赠妻子；子爻逢合，荫及儿孙；世爻、身爻如果与君爻相合，品级加增，做到大臣。具体说：五爻和太岁生合父母爻，一定赠封父母（椿萱）；生合财爻，一定封赠妻室；生扶福德（子孙），应当荫及儿孙；生合世爻、身爻，再加官爻旺相，自然品级职位高升。
rule.en: Wherever the sovereign's line generates or combines, there one sees heaven's favour conferred on that person: if the Wealth image meets generation, the wife is enfeoffed; if the Output line meets combination, descendants receive privilege; if the Self or Body is combined with the sovereign's line, one's rank is increased and one becomes a great minister. In detail: if the fifth line and Tai Sui generate or combine with Resource, the parents will surely be honoured with a title; if they generate or combine with Wealth, the wife will surely be enfeoffed; if they generate and support Output, the fortune virtue, descendants should receive privilege; if they generate or combine with the Self or Body and the Pressure line is further thriving, one's rank and post will naturally be raised high.

zh: 君爻生合何爻处，便见天恩赐那人。
财象遇生封妻室，
子爻逢合荫儿孙，
世身若得君相合，品级加增作大臣。
yi: 君爻生合在哪一爻上，就看到天恩赐给那个人；
财爻遇生，就封赠妻子；
子爻逢合，就荫及儿孙；
世爻、身爻如果与君爻相合，品级加增，做到大臣。
en: Wherever the sovereign's line generates or combines, there one sees heaven's favour conferred on that person;
if the Wealth image meets generation, the wife is enfeoffed;
if the Output line meets combination, descendants receive privilege;
if the Self or Body is combined with the sovereign's line, one's rank is increased and one becomes a great minister.

zh: 五爻与太岁生合父母，必赠椿萱。
生合财爻，必封妻室。
生扶福德，当荫儿孙。
生合世身再加官爻旺相，自当品职高陛。
yi: 五爻和太岁生合父母爻，一定赠封父母。
生合财爻，一定封赠妻室。
生扶福德（子孙），应当荫及儿孙。
生合世爻、身爻，再加官爻旺相，自然品级职位高升。
en: If the fifth line and Tai Sui generate or combine with Resource, the parents will surely be honoured with a title.
If they generate or combine with Wealth, the wife will surely be enfeoffed.
If they generate and support Output, descendants should receive privilege.
If they generate or combine with the Self or Body and the Pressure line is further thriving, one's rank and post will naturally be raised high.

note.yi: 「椿萱」是父母（椿指父、萱指母）。「荫儿孙」是朝廷凭官员的品级给子孙入学、授官的恩典。「封妻室」是封赠妻子为诰命夫人。「君相合」的「君相」疑是「君象」，指五爻、太岁这些代表君王的象。这一条与易隐官禄占「太岁五爻生合父母椿萱受赠；生合妻财室人受诰；生合子孙儿孙得荫」（YY.18）是同一套：君爻生合哪一个六亲，恩典就落在哪一个人身上。
note.en: 'Chunxuan' is the parents ('chun' for the father, 'xuan' for the mother). 'Yin er sun' is the privilege by which the court gives descendants a place in the school or an office according to the official's rank. 'Feng qishi' is the wife being given a patent as a titled lady. The 'xiang' of 'jun xiang he' is presumably 'xiang', image, the images that stand for the sovereign such as the fifth line and Tai Sui. This entry is the same set as 'Tai Sui and the fifth line generate or combine with Resource, the parents are honoured; with Wealth, the wife receives a patent; with Output, the children receive privilege' in the Yi Yin divination on official salary (YY.18): whichever of the six kin the sovereign's line generates or combines with, the favour falls on that person.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 36: Conferment of titles and patents
units.title: 恩封诰命：鬼发父兴迎诰命、父空财动绝皇恩，官鬼休囚宜嘱托、文书破绝莫劳心，来召来宣同此例、去朝去奏照其因；卦内官父两旺定沐洪恩，父若空亡难迎诰命，妻财独发克制文书难沾雨露，鬼值休囚夤缘为美父临空绝枉使机谋，君来宣召臣去朝天皆喜君爻生世，官旺为佳各忌帝位克身鬼空不吉

rule.yi: 官鬼发动、父爻兴旺，就迎来诰命；父爻落空、财爻发动，就断绝皇恩；官鬼休囚，适宜托人嘱托；文书（父母）被破、被绝，就不要费心。被召、被宣同这个取法；去朝见、去上奏，按它的缘由来断。卦里官爻、父爻都旺，一定沐浴洪恩；父爻如果空亡，难迎诰命；妻财独自发动、克制文书，难沾雨露；官鬼休囚，托人走门路为好；父爻临空、绝，白费机谋。君王来宣召、臣子去朝见，都喜欢君爻生世爻；官爻旺相为好，各自都忌帝位克制身爻，官鬼落空不吉。
rule.en: If Pressure moves and Resource flourishes, one welcomes the patent; if Resource is Void and Wealth moves, the sovereign's favour is cut off; if Pressure is resting or imprisoned it is fitting to entrust the matter to someone; if the document is broken or extinct, do not trouble your heart; being summoned or called follows this same rule, and going to court or memorialising follows its causes. If in the hexagram the star of office and Resource are both thriving, one will surely bathe in great favour; if Resource is Void, it is hard to receive the patent; if Wealth moves alone and controls the document, it is hard to share in the rain and dew of favour; if Pressure is resting or imprisoned, going through connections is best; if Resource is Void or extinct, scheming is in vain. Whether the sovereign summons or the minister goes to court, in all cases it is welcome for the sovereign's line to generate the Self; a thriving star of office is good, in each case the throne's position controlling the Body is feared, and Pressure Void is ominous.

zh: 鬼发父兴迎诰命，父空财动绝皇恩，
官鬼休囚宜嘱托，文书破绝莫劳心，
来召来宣同此例，去朝去奏照其因。
yi: 官鬼发动、父爻兴旺，就迎来诰命；父爻落空、财爻发动，就断绝皇恩；
官鬼休囚，适宜托人嘱托；文书（父母）被破、被绝，就不要费心；
被召、被宣同这个取法，去朝见、去上奏按它的缘由来断。
en: If Pressure moves and Resource flourishes, one welcomes the patent; if Resource is Void and Wealth moves, the sovereign's favour is cut off;
if Pressure is resting or imprisoned it is fitting to entrust the matter to someone; if the document is broken or extinct, do not trouble your heart;
being summoned or called follows this same rule, and going to court or memorialising follows its causes.

zh: 卦内官父两旺，定沐洪恩。
父若空亡，难迎诰命。
妻财独发，克制文书，难沾雨露。
鬼值休囚，寅绿为美，父临空绝，枉使机谋。
君来宣召，臣去朝天，皆喜君爻生世。
官旺为佳，各忌帝位克身，鬼空不吉。
yi: 卦里官爻、父爻都旺相，一定沐浴洪恩。
父爻如果空亡，就难以迎来诰命。
妻财独自发动、克制文书爻，就难以沾到雨露（恩泽）。
官鬼落在休囚，托人走门路（夤缘）为好；父爻临空、绝，白费机谋。
君王来宣召、臣子去朝见，都喜欢君爻生世爻。
官爻旺相为好，各自都忌帝位克制身爻，官鬼落空不吉。
en: If in the hexagram the star of office and Resource are both thriving, one will surely bathe in great favour.
If Resource is Void, it is hard to receive the patent.
If Wealth moves alone and controls the document, it is hard to share in the rain and dew of favour.
If Pressure is resting or imprisoned, going through connections is best; if Resource is Void or extinct, scheming is in vain.
Whether the sovereign summons or the minister goes to court, in all cases it is welcome for the sovereign's line to generate the Self.
A thriving star of office is good; in each case the throne's position controlling the Body is feared, and Pressure Void is ominous.

note.yi: 「寅绿」疑是「夤缘」（攀附门路、通过关系），与诀里「官鬼休囚宜嘱托」是同一个意思，译作「托人走门路」。「迎诰命」是迎接诰命，「宣召」是君王召见，「洪恩」是大恩。「帝位克身」是五爻（君位）克制身爻。诀里「来召来宣同此例，去朝去奏照其因」是说召见、朝奏两类事，取法与诰命相同。
note.en: The 'yin lü' of 'yin lü wei mei' is presumably 'yinyuan', climbing by connections or working through relationships, which is the same sense as the verse's 'if Pressure is resting or imprisoned, it is fitting to entrust the matter to someone', and it is translated 'going through connections'. 'Ying gaoming' is receiving the patent, 'xuanzhao' is the sovereign summoning one, and 'hong en' is great favour. 'Diwei ke shen' is the fifth line (the sovereign's position) controlling the Body. The verse's 'being summoned or called follows this same rule, and going to court or memorialising follows its causes' says that being summoned and going to court or memorialise are two kinds of matter that take the same method as the patent.
